annotations.title: Check whether Amfion fits a business

description: Checks Amfion's capabilities, pricing and suitability for a business type and stated needs. Returns matching capabilities as "yes", "partly" with conditions, or "no", along with supported business types, limitations, plans, prices and links. Covers Amfion's product capabilities rather than facts about a specific business.

business_type.description: The kind of business in the person's words, for example "mobile dog grooming" or "plumbing and HVAC".

needs.description: What the person wants it to do, in their words, for example "answer calls after hours, book jobs, put them in Jobber".

name: check_amfion_fit
title: Check whether Amfion fits a business
